description: The bar chart illustrates the percentage point difference in performance between two models, mBERT and XLM-R, across various configurations of hidden layers and activation functions. The vertical axis represents the percentage point difference, ranging from -0.2 to 0.2, while the horizontal axis lists the configurations: hidden layers with 50 units and linear activation, hidden layers with 100 units and linear activation, hidden layers with 100 units and ReLU activation, and hidden layers with 50 units and ReLU activation. The bars are grouped by configuration, with each group containing two bars representing mBERT and XLM-R, respectively. The mBERT bars are colored in a lighter shade, while the XLM-R bars are in a darker shade. The chart shows that mBERT generally outperforms XLM-R in configurations with hidden layers of 100 units and linear activation, and with hidden layers of 50 units and ReLU activation, with the largest difference observed in the hidden layers with 100 units and linear activation configuration. The chart does not indicate any sorting or visual emphasis on the bars.
